prompt: Objective: cut checkout wait times at a grocery chain. What you've learned: wait times average 9 minutes at peak hours. Latest finding: only half the checkouts are staffed at peak. What is the best next step?

options.text: Measure wait times at off-peak hours
Size what staffing more checkouts at peak would do
options.feedback: Right. Half the checkouts are unstaffed at peak; size what staffing them would do.

options.text: Size the scanning speed gaps across cashiers
options.feedback: Secondary: half the checkouts are empty.

options.text: Price out self-checkout machines for every single store
options.feedback: That jumps to an expensive fix before testing the obvious one.

explanation: Only half the checkouts are staffed at peak. Size the effect of staffing more.
